plan.title: Forward auction auto title waits for location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction with a forward-auction-compatible pricing configuration.
Select the forward auction template before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 while leaving its location unset.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify that the automatic title remains empty while no location is selected.
Choose Plant Name as the product location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Forward Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify that selecting the location generates the expected forward-auction title.
